text: DSH Selection Comments 是面向 DSH Web 与桌面端的会话选区注释插件。它在输入框区域加入注释界面，并将注释引用注册为输入触发器。用户可选中会话文字写下注释，以编号锚点和紧凑引用管理草稿，也可编辑、删除、重新加入或集中查看注释；提交时引用会展开为原文与注释，兼容宿主还能将已发送内容显示为可展开卡片。适合需要在长对话中标注上下文并随消息提交的用户。代码未要求额外密钥或外部账号。

DSH Selection Comments lets DSH Web and desktop users annotate conversation passages. Select text, add a note, and manage numbered draft references; submission expands each reference to its quote and note. Compatible hosts show sent comments as expandable cards.
我想给 DSH 对话里的一段原文加批注，并在发送消息时一起带上。
能不能把聊天里的引用和我的注释收进紧凑草稿，之后还能编辑？
How can I annotate a passage in a DSH conversation and include the quote with my next message?
DSH Selection Comments 的功能「选区批注与草稿引用」：在会话中选中文字后填写注释，界面保存带编号的注释，并把紧凑引用加入输入草稿；提交时引用编解码器展开为原文和注释。
DSH Selection Comments 的功能「注释管理与发送后阅读」：通过注释列表或编号锚点查看、编辑、删除和重新加入注释；兼容宿主会把已发送的原文与注释呈现为可展开卡片。

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Features：- Select text to add a comment, with a numbered badge anchored beside the passage.
- **0.3.3:** Keep selection actions working in DSH's grouped/nested process flows while isolating separate conversation panes.
- Keep quote + comment in one compact draft reference; expand both when submitting.
- **0.3.2:** Read sent quotes/comments as compact, expandable cards instead of raw XML tags, including compatible message history.
- Edit, delete, or re-add a comment from its badge/reference; review everything in **All comments**.
- Keep the composer uncluttered: no permanent comments toolbar or extra footer counter.

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Install：For DSH Web or Windows Desktop; see the [compatibility matrix](docs/compatibility.md) for the API baseline and tested scope.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/O-OII/dsh-selection-comments.git
cd dsh-selection-comments
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --ignore-scripts .
```

Use the official DSH CLI supplied with your target installation; replace `desktop` with your intended profile. The client bundle is included—no build required.

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Use in four steps：1. Select a passage in the conversation and click **注释 / Comment**.
2. Write your note and choose **Add comment**, or press `Ctrl/⌘+Enter`.
3. Click a numbered badge or draft reference to edit, delete, re-add, or open **All comments**.
4. Submit normally in DSH: references expand to the original quote and your note, not just a number.
@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · After sending：*Browser capture of production plugin components with public sample data, not a private session or model-delivery test.*

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · After sending：On compatible hosts, sent messages and compatible history show numbered quotation/comment cards. **Expand** reads the full content; queue previews stay compact. Cards are snapshots of the sent text—editing/deleting an unsent annotation does not change them. Model context and message Copy/Edit retain the full original text. Hosts without the official user-text extension seam show the original XML instead; see [details and limits](docs/usage.md#sent-cards-and-historical-messages--发送后与历史消息卡片).
@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · After sending：Both filled comment actions use the skin's matched primary fill/foreground/hover tokens, including skins with transparent base surfaces.

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Language：**Simplified Chinese is the default**, even with an English browser or DSH. Choose **English** or **Follow DSH** in the comment dialog's language selector; `Esc` closes the dialog.

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Review your comments：**All comments** shows quotes, notes, and draft status. **Delete all comments** removes this session's comments, draft references, and plugin tab cache.

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · Recovery：Comments can recover after refresh in the **same browser tab** via `sessionStorage`; this is not cross-tab/cloud sync or secure erasure—see [privacy and limits](docs/privacy.md).

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 功能：- 选中会话原文添加注释，在原文附近显示编号角标。
- **0.3.3：** 修复 DSH 分组/嵌套过程正文中划词按钮不出现，同时保持不同会话区域隔离。
- 原文与注释组成一个紧凑引用，提交时才展开完整内容。
- **0.3.2：** 发送后以可展开的紧凑原文/注释卡片阅读，不再显示裸 XML；兼容格式的历史消息同样生效。
- 通过角标或草稿引用编辑、删除、重新加入，在「全部注释」集中查看。
- 保持输入框简洁，不增加常驻注释工具栏或底部计数入口。

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 安装：适用于 DSH Web 或 Windows Desktop；API 基线与实测范围见[兼容性说明](docs/compatibility.md)。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/O-OII/dsh-selection-comments.git
cd dsh-selection-comments
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --ignore-scripts .
```

请使用目标安装所附的官方 DSH CLI，需要其他配置时替换 `desktop`。仓库已包含客户端 bundle，安装无需构建。

@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 四步使用：1. 在会话正文选中文字，点击「注释」。
2. 填写内容，点击「添加注释」或按 `Ctrl/⌘+Enter`。
3. 点击编号角标或草稿引用，可编辑、删除、重新加入，或进入「全部注释」。
4. 使用 DSH 正常提交，引用会展开为原文与注释，而不是只发送编号。
@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 界面语言：**默认简体中文**，不受浏览器或 DSH 恰好为英文影响；可在注释弹窗的语言选择器切换 **English** 或「跟随 DSH」，按 `Esc` 关闭弹窗。
@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 集中管理：「全部注释」展示原文、注释与草稿状态；「删除全部注释」会一并移除该会话的注释、草稿引用和本插件标签页缓存。
@o-oii/dsh-selection-comments README · 恢复边界：注释通过 `sessionStorage` 支持**同一浏览器标签页内刷新恢复**，不提供跨标签页或云同步，也不是安全擦除机制，详见[隐私与限制](docs/privacy.md)。
